Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.ui

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.ui
  • Class
    Description
    ConnectionDialog
    A modal form for creating or editing a ConnectionProfile: choose a driver (which pre-fills the JDBC URL template and driver class), enter the URL, credentials and per-connection options, and optionally test the connection before saving.
    DbManagerMainPanel
    The Database Manager's root panel: a toolbar, the connection navigator on the left, a tabbed SQL editor/results area on the right, and a message log with a status line at the bottom.
    NavigatorTree
    The database navigator: a lazy JTree of saved connection profiles that expands into schemas, tables/views and columns on demand.
    NavigatorTree.Actions
    Callbacks the navigator needs from the hosting panel.
    NavigatorTree.TableSelection
    The table a user double-clicked, resolved to its qualified coordinates.
    ResultsTable
    The results grid: a JTable over a paging ResultTableModel, with First/Prev/Next/Last controls, a page-position label and a one-line message showing the last result's row count / update count / error.
    ResultTableModel
    A read-only TableModel that pages over the rows of a QueryResult held in memory.
    SettingsDialog
    A modal form for the application-wide AppSettings: row caps, paging, timeouts, null text, editor font size, and the security-sensitive "allow saving passwords" switch (with an explicit warning).
    SqlEditorTab
    One SQL editor tab: a syntax-highlighted query pane on top, a Run/Stop bar, and the results grid below.
    SqlEditorTab.Runner
    Supplies the currently active connection and settings to the tab.
    SqlHighlighter
    Lightweight SQL syntax highlighting for a JTextPane: keywords, string literals, numbers and -- / /* */ comments are colored as the user types.
